##### Project general facts

Mulberry 2 Park Heights by Emaar Properties is a contemporary residential development located within Dubai Hills Estate, offering a refined balance between urban living and green surroundings. The project consists of two elegant mid-rise buildings, featuring a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with thoughtfully designed layouts. Positioned to overlook the community’s central park, it creates a peaceful and visually open living environment enhanced by modern architectural design.

The development is designed to support a well-rounded and active lifestyle, with a wide range of amenities for residents. These include temperature-controlled swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, tennis courts, children’s play areas, indoor activity spaces, and a clubhouse, alongside landscaped relaxation zones. Surrounded by green walkways and connected to retail, cafés, and schools, the project offers both convenience and a strong sense of community, while being just moments away from Dubai Hills Park and Dubai Hills Mall.

The interiors are finished in a warm, modern style, with neutral tones that enhance comfort and space. Large windows and private terraces allow for abundant natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor living, while kitchens come fully fitted and bedrooms include built-in wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms. High-quality materials and clean detailing complete the overall aesthetic. Residences are offered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas Holding, it represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design.

At the heart of Dubai Hills is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

Dubai Hills is not just a residential development - it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation.
